comment.body:
But we already have many similar rules for fixing scroll-lock using CSS rules combined with cosmetic rules.

I've come up with the following rule for secure support based on your feedback, but it won't support iOS.

```adblock
!#if (!adguard_app_ios && !adguard_ext_android_cb)
pinterest.com#$#body[style*="overflow: hidden;"] { overflow: auto !important; }
pinterest.com##body > div > div[role="dialog"]:has(> div[data-test-id="mobile-signup-mask"])
!#endif
```

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

comment.body:
By disabling the `Mobile App Banner Filter`, I found where the scroll-lock is being caused.

After applying the `.min-h-dvh div[data-interaction="app-store-obstruction"]` rule, it shows the interaction blocking, just as you said: "It's blocked after some delay, sometimes right away."

Clicking the close button via scriptlet is required, so I've removed this rule at https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/pull/237931/commits/b5a788c889c60960d1a827d1edb487dcf61ae654.

Please re-test with the x.com rules group below. It should work fine.

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/HEAD/AnnoyancesFilter/MobileApp/sections/mobile-app_specific.txt#L4376-L4385

Даже при выключенном DNS в настройках панели управления. Убраны все фильтры и блокировки. В белый список добавлен сам сайт, где должны отображаться виджеты, так и домены виджетов: tpemd.com, emrldtp.com. > При удалении на роутере подключения к Adguard DNS все виджеты отображаются корректно. > > Странный момент! > При включенной фильтрации DNS сервера, к которому подключен и Adguard VPN, включить VPN, то виджеты открываются. > > Я не стал подключать GPT, чтоб он Вам всё разжевал, думаю, тут и так всё понятно. Виджеты emrldtp.com, tpemd.com от партнёрки Travelpayouts блокируются при подключении DNS роутера Кинетик Рейсер. > > Очень нравится пользоваться вашими продуктами. Жду решения проблемы.
